description: De Pere, WI – Small businessman and Republican nominee for Wisconsin’s 8th Congressional District Tony Wied today appeared on the “Regular Joe Show” and made his case for why he is the right person to represent WI-08. Wied discussed his plan to go to Washington to lower prices, secure the border, and reign in out-of-control government spending. […]
